decision.observation: Deselected again; unit unchanged at ~0.50,0.31; turn still 2. Same persistent pattern: selecting the unit then clicking a land tile just deselects without moving. The Eagle Warrior (the red circular icon with an eagle head) sits on a one-tile promontory jutting into the lake, just north of the city banner.
decision.hypothesis: The unit really is trapped: south is the city itself, and the lake surrounds north/west; the only land neighbors are within the city or lake. With 2/2 movement it should be able to move to the city tile's land, but that's the city center (occupied by the city, impassable). This is a genuine no-move deadlock. The '!' button is the End Turn button; it keeps selecting the stuck unit because it 'needs orders' but has no legal move. In many Civ builds, the End Turn button also shows a separate small 'next turn' when forced. Perhaps pressing Escape then Return, or just pressing the big button twice.
decision.memory: Persistent no-move deadlock on promontory unit. End-turn button only reselects it.
